name: live-v19-repair-deep-link
objective: v2.3 replan V19 on a real SillyTavern (no model needed). Plan 09 says the HUD chip deep-links Repair and the drawer footer carries the entry points. With no memory model chosen, the HUD setup chip (`#so-hud-setup`, which replaced the needs-setup pipeline chip in v2.7 04) must open the settings panel AND reveal its Repair row (`#so-entry-repair` gains `so-revealed`), not just open the panel; the drawer footer must show `Repair: <what the story loses>` and land on the same row. Each control is hit-tested first, so a covered control fails here instead of being clicked by script. The memory model is install state: so-scenario restores the extraction settings at cleanup.

import_story.title: SO-V19 Repair
import_story.description: One checkpoint; the check is about setup, not play.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ profileId: null }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (!snapshot.pipeline.needsSetup) throw new Error(`clearing the memory model did not put the pipeline in needs-setup: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.pipeline)}`); const nav = document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block'); if (nav?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400)); return { pipeline: snapshot.pipeline.state, navOpen: document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer') };

document.querySelector('#so-hud-setup').click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)); const repair = document.getElementById('so-entry-repair'); const nav = document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block'); const revealed = repair?.classList.contains('so-revealed') ?? false; const visible = Boolean(repair && repair.offsetParent !== null); if (!nav?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) throw new Error('the HUD chip did not open the settings panel'); if (!visible || !revealed) throw new Error(`the HUD chip opened the panel but did not reveal the Repair row (visible=${visible}, revealed=${revealed})`); return { navOpen: true, revealed, repair: repair.textContent.slice(0, 120) };

const nav = document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block'); if (nav?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2500)); return { navOpen: document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer'), stillRevealed: document.getElementById('so-entry-repair')?.classList.contains('so-revealed') };

const button = document.getElementById('so-drawer-repair'); if (!button?.textContent?.startsWith('Repair: ')) throw new Error(`the footer Repair button does not say what the story loses: ${button?.textContent}`); const label = button.textContent; button.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)); const repair = document.getElementById('so-entry-repair'); const revealed = repair?.classList.contains('so-revealed') ?? false; if (!document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer') || !revealed) throw new Error(`the footer Repair button did not land on the Repair row (revealed=${revealed})`); document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); return { label, revealed };
